item.title: uml-mcp — UML diagrams from chat via MCP
item.description:
uml-mcp gives an MCP client real diagram tools: an assistant supplies Mermaid, PlantUML, or another supported diagram source, and the server returns rendered output and useful links. The current repository documents five tools and a catalog of roughly 37 Kroki-backed types. Those counts describe the documented interface, not a rendering benchmark. Version française.

item.title: Python library for MarketWatch virtual trading
item.description: I wanted to automate chores in MarketWatch’s virtual stock game (paper trading, not a real broker). marketwatch on PyPI is the small client I shipped — watchlists, game state, portfolio, orders, leaderboard. Version française.

item.title: Live chat and support platforms compared (3CX, ManyChat, Kommunicate, Chatwoot)
item.description: I wrote these notes while helping a bilingual storefront team choose live chat, a bot, and something agents could actually work from. The four products below are not interchangeable: one is a phone system with chat bolted on, one is marketing automation, one is managed bot-to-human handoff, and one is an open-source helpdesk you can host yourself. Pricing and channels change often—use this as a map, then confirm on each vendor’s site. Version française.
